sources.entry: AInnotator - Screenshot annotation tool that turns numbered marks, notes, and redactions into one self-explaining image to paste into Claude Code, Codex, or ChatGPT, including over SSH. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/porco-rs/ainnotator) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: AInnotator is a macOS menu-bar screenshot tool that lets you mark a screen area with numbered, color-coded annotations and produces one image with a legend, ready to paste into AI chat or coding agents, including over SSH.
summary.what_it_does: Press a hotkey to freeze the screen, then drag to select an area, or click for a whole display or window. Draw boxes, ovals, arrows and highlights, or drop numbered points, and tag each mark by color (red bug, purple change, green keep, yellow question) with an optional short note. An X key blacks out private areas before the image is saved, and C crops. Finishing produces a card that combines the screenshot with a legend listing every mark and a footer noting the source app or page and how many areas were redacted. The card is placed on the clipboard so browsers receive the picture and terminals receive the file path. For agents on another machine, it can copy the finished card over the user's own SSH setup after the user confirms each machine. Captures and their JSON marks are stored locally in ~/.ainnotator and deleted after 1, 7 or 30 days.
use_cases: point at a bug in a screenshot and send it to an AI assistant
annotate UI mockups for a coding agent
redact private data before sharing a screenshot
paste an annotated screen capture into Claude Code or Codex over SSH
give ChatGPT or claude.ai a marked-up image with a legend
quick numbered callouts on a screen capture
how_to_run: Download the signed DMG from the releases page and drag AInnotator to Applications.
Open AInnotator; it appears in the menu bar.
Press Option-Shift-A and grant screen recording permission in System Settings when asked.
Drag to select an area, add marks and notes, then press Return twice.
Press Command-V in the target app to paste.
notable: Numbered, color-coded marks plus a legend card that tells the model what each mark means
Clipboard contents adapt per target: picture for browsers, file path for terminals, and [Image #1] for Claude Code and Codex
Copies the finished card to a remote machine over the user's own ssh, asking once per machine
Redaction overwrites pixels before writing, and the unredacted capture is never saved
Native Swift with no web view and no dependencies, per the README
caveats: Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon and screen recording permission
Remote paste works only from Ghostty, Terminal or iTerm over ssh; VS Code's terminal, mosh, tmux started before ssh, and cloud environments without SSH are not covered
Maintained when time permits and not accepting pull requests or feature requests
Claude and ChatGPT desktop apps have not been tested
